tasks.title: Prove TDLight on JDK 25 and land the binding behind the TdlibFacade (spike)
tasks.dod: TDLight natives load on eclipse-temurin:25-jre (linux x64) and on macOS, two facade clients run in one process, a test-server sign-in completes, and spike.md records image growth, memory per client and the idle-session-termination timing.

tasks.title: Promote the owner_key, linked_account and channel migrations into the live Flyway tree
tasks.dod: The three staged pairs are promoted to db/migration V…__*.sql + db/rollback U…__*.sql, MigrationRollbackIT applies up → down → up for all of them, and a schema IT proves the telegram_user_id uniqueness and the channel cascade.

tasks.title: Add OwnerKeys envelope encryption with the master-key check and reset, and SignInSessions.isLive
tasks.dod: OwnerKeys seals and opens with AES-256-GCM bound to an AAD, lazily creates the Owner key, refuses to start on a missing or wrong master key once a key exists, reports "not set up" on a fresh installation without one, performs the explicit reset, and SignInSessions.isLive answers per session — all covered by unit + integration tests.

tasks.title: Define the TelegramSessions port, its in-process events and the fake Telegram adapter
tasks.dod: The TelegramSessions port and its port types and events exist at the telegram module root, the fake adapter (selected by telex.telegram.adapter=fake) scripts codes, 2FA, flood waits, banned/unregistered numbers, connectivity drops, session termination and N chats, and unit tests drive every scripted branch.

tasks.title: Manage Telegram session directories: per-session dir, destroy with one-minute retry, startup orphan sweep
tasks.dod: Every Telegram session gets one directory under telex.telegram.sessions-dir, destroy deletes it and retries failures every minute, and sweepOrphans(referenced) deletes every directory not in the referenced set — covered by unit tests on a temp directory.

tasks.title: Implement the tdlight adapter: TDLib auth states, errors and chat list mapped to the port
tasks.dod: The tdlight adapter implements every TelegramSessions operation over TdlibFacade, maps authorization/connection states to Ready/Connecting/Closed and TDLib errors to port outcomes, streams the main + archived chat list as TelegramChatsChanged batches, and an IT proves the raw TDLib key appears nowhere in the DB, logs or session volume.

tasks.title: Build the LinkedAccount aggregate: rules, states, masked phone, repository, events and the account limit
tasks.dod: The LinkedAccount aggregate decides new-link / signed-in-again / refuse (other Owner, already linked, limit, mismatch) by Telegram identity, its JdbcClient repository serves every data-model access pattern Owner-scoped (including the chat count and the advisory-locked limit count), and the four messaging event types exist — covered by unit tests and a repository IT.

tasks.title: Start, resume, cancel and expire the in-memory linking attempt (one per Owner)
tasks.dod: Linking.start/get/cancel enforce one open attempt per Owner, refuse when linking isn't set up or the limit is reached, resume an open attempt from any tab, and the one-minute sweep discards attempts after 15 min without a step or when their Sign-in Session is no longer live, always destroying the attempt's Telegram session — covered by an ApplicationModuleTest on the fake adapter with a fixed clock.

tasks.title: Run the phone, code, resend and password steps with Telegram's refusals and waits
tasks.dod: Linking.submitPhone/resendCode/submitCode/submitPassword check ownership, live Sign-in Session and step, map every Telegram outcome to the step's result or domain problem (wait ends the attempt with retryAt), never store or log the typed values, and an ApplicationModuleTest covers every branch on the fake adapter.

tasks.title: Complete an authorized attempt: link a new account, sign in again, or refuse and log out
tasks.dod: On Telegram authorizing an attempt, messaging either inserts a Connected Linked Account with the sealed TDLib key and AccountLinked, swaps the new session into the Session-lost target with LinkedAccountStateChanged, or logs out and destroys the new session with the right refusal — inside one transaction under the Owner's advisory lock — covered by an ApplicationModuleTest on the fake adapter.

tasks.title: Unlink an account: bounded sign-out, one-transaction delete with AccountUnlinked, then destroy the session
tasks.dod: LinkedAccounts.unlink logs the session out with a 10 s bound, deletes the account, its sealed key and its chat list and records AccountUnlinked in one transaction, discards a Sign-in-again attempt that targets it, destroys the session directory after commit and reports signOutConfirmed — covered by an ApplicationModuleTest for the confirmed and unreachable cases.

tasks.title: Reconnect accounts on boot and follow Telegram's session state (Connected, Reconnecting, Session lost)
tasks.dod: On boot messaging applies a master-key reset if one happened, sweeps orphan session directories, reopens every non-Session-lost account in parallel, and maps TelegramSessionStateChanged (newer sequence only) to the stored state with LinkedAccountStateChanged on a real change — covered by an ApplicationModuleTest with two accounts and a controlled clock.

tasks.title: Sync each account's chat list into channel rows with throttled progress events
tasks.dod: TelegramChatsChanged upserts and removes channel rows by (linked_account_id, telegram_chat_id), stores chats_total and chat_sync_completed_at, and publishes LinkedAccountSyncProgressed at most once per second per account with a trailing publish — covered by an ApplicationModuleTest with a 500-chat fake account, including resume after a restart.

tasks.title: Expose list and unlink of my Linked Accounts, and back getMe.linkedAccountCount with messaging
tasks.dod: GET /api/v1/linked-accounts and DELETE /api/v1/linked-accounts/{id} answer exactly the contract (Owner-scoped, 404 not-found for anything not the caller's, signOutConfirmed), getMe.linkedAccountCount comes from messaging, and an IT validates every response against openapi.yaml.

tasks.title: Expose the linking-attempt endpoints with the contract's problem codes, validation and Retry-After
tasks.dod: The seven linking operations answer exactly openapi.yaml (status, problem code, extensions retryAt/passwordHint/limit/step, Retry-After, validation-failed), request values never reach logs, and an IT validates every documented response on the fake adapter.

tasks.title: Serve the live-update SSE stream of invalidation hints per Owner
tasks.dod: GET /api/v1/live-updates streams `event: hint` / `data: linked-accounts` to every open tab of the affected Owner after each messaging account event (≤ 1 per second per Owner), sends a 25 s heartbeat with the contract headers, never bumps session activity and closes when the Sign-in Session ends — covered by an IT.

tasks.title: Wire the Operator config, the session volume and the README Telegram setup step
tasks.dod: application.yaml binds every TELEX_* setting of the feature, the local profile uses the fake adapter unless real credentials are set, compose mounts the telex-tdlib volume and passes the variables, the README has the Operator's Telegram setup step, and the tech-spec event table and sad §8 Events reflect messaging as publisher and the in-process telegram events.

tasks.title: Add the SPA API clients, the single SSE live-update client and all new copy
tasks.dod: Typed clients for the ten operations, a single EventSource client that invalidates the linked-accounts query on a hint and everything on reconnect, background refetches with X-Telex-Background, and every string from screens.md in messages.ts (linking, accounts, banner groups + the 15 new problem codes) — covered by Vitest.

tasks.title: Build LinkedAccountSummary, port StatusBanner, extend CodeInput, Icon and PageFrame
tasks.dod: LinkedAccountSummary renders every account state (line and row variants) with icon + words and the sync line, StatusBanner shows the account-disconnected condition for one or several lost accounts with its action, CodeInput takes length and label, Icon has unlink, PageFrame has the Accounts button and the banner slot — covered by Vitest at the component level.

tasks.title: Build the SCR-02 wizard steps: phone, code, password with their validation and refusals
tasks.dod: SCR-02 renders the step the server answers and implements the loading, phone, phone-validation, phone-refused, code, code-validation, code-wrong, code-expired, resending, resent, password, password-validation, password-wrong, submitting, telegram-unavailable and step-mismatch states — covered by Vitest at 360 px and 1280 px layouts.

tasks.title: Build the SCR-02 outcomes: wait countdown, refusals, attempt ended, cancel and success
tasks.dod: SCR-02 implements the wait, refused-other-owner, refused-already-linked, refused-limit, refused-mismatch, attempt-ended, starting-again, cancelling, success and error states, with the countdown announced only at start and end — covered by Vitest.

tasks.title: Make SCR-10 Inbox start linking and list one line per Linked Account
tasks.dod: SCR-10 implements loading, default (empty) with a working Connect Telegram, starting, start-refused, resumed, with-accounts, linked, live, banner and error states, driven by listMyLinkedAccounts instead of Me.linkedAccountCount — covered by Vitest.

tasks.title: Build SCR-60 Accounts: the list with states, Add account, Sign in again and the unlink dialog
tasks.dod: SCR-60 implements loading, default list with every row state, empty, starting, start-refused, resumed, unlink-confirm, unlinking, unlinked, unlinked-unconfirmed, unlink-gone, linked, live, banner and error — covered by Vitest.

tasks.title: Prove nothing is left behind or leaked: unlink dump, restart delivery, registry and log scans
tasks.dod: Integration tests on the fake adapter prove an unlink (confirmed and unreachable) leaves no identifying row, key or session dir, a crash after the commit is cleaned by the startup sweep, AccountUnlinked is delivered after a restart, and no event_publication payload, log line or metric tag carries a phone, name, Telegram id, chat title, code or password.

tasks.title: Add Playwright end-to-end tests of linking, live state and unlink at 360 px and 1280 px with axe
tasks.dod: Playwright on the fake adapter at 360 px and 1280 px links an account with 2FA, hits a wrong code and a wait, reloads and opens a second tab mid-wizard, sees Session lost with the banner and signs in again, unlinks, and the axe scan reports 0 violations on every screen state visited.

tasks.title: Publish sync progress inside a transaction, write the sync time from the Clock, time the sync once
tasks.dod: Sync progress reaches the SPA as a live hint with no surrounding transaction in the test; no incomplete event_publication rows after a sync; completedAt equals the fixed Clock; the duration timer has exactly one sample per completed sync.

tasks.title: Start chat sync only after the Linked Account is committed, report Telegram's real total, drop chats left meanwhile
tasks.dod: A freshly linked account (and a signed-in-again one) syncs its full chat list with both adapters; total is Telegram's total or null; stale chats removed on load completion; no test asserts the old buggy behaviour.

tasks.title: Unlink: report an unconfirmed sign-out for Session lost, and sign out the session the delete actually removed
tasks.dod: Session lost unlink reports unconfirmed with both adapters; the unlink/sign-in-again race leaves nothing behind.

tasks.title: Linking refusals: end the attempt on an unregistered number, 503 when Telegram does not answer at start, clear codeLength, whitespace phone is 422
tasks.dod: No 500 on any refusal path; contract validator passes on the new responses; SPA shows the refusal at the code step.

tasks.title: Log out sign-ins Telegram authorized but teleX did not finish, and never hang on a failed client open
tasks.dod: No authorized-but-abandoned session survives a discard; shutdown never hangs on a failed open.

tasks.title: Make the SSE emitter registry add and remove atomic per Owner
tasks.dod: No orphaned streams under concurrent open/remove.

tasks.title: Cover the remaining contract responses over HTTP, run completions concurrently, and restart the app for real
tasks.dod: Every declared response of the feature's operations is seen by the contract validator at least once; the race paths and a real restart are exercised.

tasks.title: Bring sad §6/§7, the api-sync open questions and the screens.md registry in line with the code
tasks.dod: No artifact contradicts the code on these points; OQs ticked.

tasks.title: SPA failures: domain 503 refusals stay on the page, SCR-02 never throws in render, step errors always give feedback, cache the new account
tasks.dod: AC-119 refusal visible in the real app shell; no render-throw; every failure gives feedback.

tasks.title: SCR-60 and the banner: linked Toast, Reconnecting and Session lost notes, banner refusals, unlink focus, one-shot arrival Toast, icon and copy fixes
tasks.dod: Every SCR-60 and banner state in screens.md renders; a11y focus correct.

tasks.title: Render SCR-02 in the confirmed onboarding card layout
tasks.dod: SCR-02 matches screens.md shared conventions at phone and desktop widths.

tasks.title: Reopen the live-update stream when the browser has closed it, with capped backoff
tasks.dod: Live state recovers after a teleX restart without a refocus.

tasks.title: End-to-end: complete Sign in again, Reconnecting to Connected, banner goes away, AC-119, password and phone refusals
tasks.dod: The T25 DoD is met in full (sign in again completed) plus the paths above, at 360 px and 1280 px, 0 axe violations.

tasks.title: Sign in again racing an unlink never reports success on a deleted account or leaves an authorized session behind
tasks.dod: The race leaves nothing behind and never reports success; the UnlinkIT race test fails if the replacement-session branch is removed.

tasks.title: Real adapter: logOut is false for a closed session, and the chat total ignores folder counts
tasks.dod: Fake and real adapters agree on `logOut` for every not-open session; the total is Telegram's Main + Archive count.

tasks.title: Unregistered number with no replacement session answers 422, and Resend ends the attempt on every phone refusal
tasks.dod: No 503 on an attempt that has already ended; server and SPA agree that every phone refusal ends the attempt.

tasks.title: Make the sync-in-transaction and AC-110 tests able to fail on their regressions
tasks.dod: Each test fails when its guarded behaviour is removed and passes on the current code.

tasks.title: Report Session lost through the shell's Status Banner, with the account name and a working Sign in again
tasks.dod: One C-04 banner in the shell for every condition including Session lost; AC-122 banner behaviour unchanged for the Owner; N6 fixed; e2e green at both widths.

tasks.title: SPA polish: unlink focus, a dismissible SCR-02 load-failure Toast with Retry, one Toast slot, one refusal lookup, stronger tests
tasks.dod: All four UI defects fixed with tests; the two tests can fail on their regressions; `pnpm run check` clean.

tasks.title: Bring screens.md, sad §7, data-model, events.md, the contract and spec §8 in line with the code
tasks.dod: Every D1–D5 item matches the code; no stale PageFrame reference remains in screens.md.
